GET /healthz.summary: Liveness for a load balancer or uptime check. No auth, no data.

POST /api/auth/request.summary: Send a sign-in code by SMS to a phone number (creates nothing yet).

request.lang: string: ar | en, language of the SMS

response.newUser: boolean: this number has no account yet (the next step then needs a name)
response.devCode: string: the code, ONLY in development

POST /api/auth/verify.summary: Check the SMS code. Starts a session (cookie), or asks for the two-step PIN.

request.name: string: required for a new account

response.needPin: boolean: the account has a PIN; no session yet
response.ticket: string: present with needPin, valid 5 minutes, use it on /api/auth/pin

POST /api/auth/pin.summary: Second step of sign-in: the 6-digit PIN. Starts the session. 5 wrong tries lock it for 15 minutes.

POST /api/auth/pin-forgot.summary: Start the 7-day wait after which the SMS code alone signs in and the PIN is cleared.

response.resetAt: integer: when the wait ends (ms since epoch)

response.name: string
response.has_pin: integer: 1 when two-step verification is on

PATCH /api/me.summary: Change name, language, read receipts, push preview.

POST /api/me/phone/request.summary: Change phone number, step 1: a code goes to the NEW number.

POST /api/me/phone/confirm.summary: Change phone number, step 2: confirm with the code. The account, circles and history stay.

POST /api/me/pin.summary: Turn on or change two-step verification (6-digit PIN). Changing needs the current PIN.

request.current: string: required when a PIN already exists

POST /api/me/pin/remove.summary: Turn two-step verification off (needs the PIN).

GET /api/circles.summary: The chat list: circles, groups and one-to-one chats with last message, unread count and personal settings.

POST /api/circles.summary: Create a family circle (with the agent) or a plain group.

POST /api/direct.summary: Open (or create) a one-to-one chat with a registered person by phone number.

POST /api/circles/join.summary: Join a circle with its invite code.

GET /api/circles/:id.summary: One circle: members (with delivered/read marks), settings, last sequence number.

GET /api/circles/:id/messages.summary: Messages. Sync by sequence (`after_seq`) or by revision (`after_rev`, also returns edits and deletions); pages are oldest-first.

query.after_seq: integer: messages with seq greater than this
query.after_rev: integer: messages whose revision is greater than this

POST /api/circles/:id/messages.summary: Send a text message. Idempotent by `client_msg_id`: a retry returns 200 with the same id.

request.preview: string: a link that is in the body and was just asked from POST /api/link-preview; attaches its card

POST /api/circles/:id/read.summary: Mark messages read up to a sequence number.

PATCH /api/messages/:mid.summary: Edit your own text message (15 minutes).

DELETE /api/messages/:mid.summary: Delete for everyone (member 48 hours, manager 7 days; an opened sealed letter only by its author).

POST /api/messages/:mid/react.summary: React with one of the allowed emoji.

POST /api/circles/:id/attachments.summary: Send up to 10 files with a caption as ONE message (multipart form). Either `file` parts, or `upload` = ids of finished resumable uploads in order (never both). `thumb`, `w`, `h` are per file, in the same order.

request.view_once: '1': opened one time by each recipient (one photo or video, or one voice note; no caption, thumbnail or transcript)

POST /api/circles/:id/voice.summary: Send a voice note (multipart form). Keep the recording on the device until this answers, and retry with the same client_msg_id: it is stored once.

request.audio: file: audio/webm, mp4, ogg, mpeg or wav, up to 5 MB
request.duration: integer: milliseconds, as measured by the recorder
request.waveform: string: JSON array of 4-64 numbers 0-100, the shape measured on the device
request.transcript: string: optional, from on-device speech recognition
request.view_once: '1': opened one time by each recipient (one photo or video, or one voice note; no caption, thumbnail or transcript)

POST /api/circles/:id/sealed.summary: Write a sealed letter (text, voice, video or photo) opened on a date, an occasion or after the author's death (event and death need the agent on).

GET /api/circles/:id/sealed-envelopes.summary: What the family sees: how many letters are waiting and how far the agent is from concluding, never titles or content.

GET /api/me/memory.summary: The agent's archive across all your family circles, newest first.

GET /api/me/export.summary: Download your data in an open format (zip).

GET /api/circles/:id/book.summary: The yearly family book as a printable page.

GET /api/admin/reports.summary: Reports sent by members, open first. The only place staff see message text (of reported messages); each look is written to the audit log.

GET /api/admin/metrics.summary: Latency percentiles, counters and live connections of THIS node. No content, no names.

POST /api/admin/reports/:id/action.summary: A moderator's decision on a report: dismiss, warn, remove_message, suspend_user, ban, escalate. suspend_user and ban also need the user-moderation permission. Sealed letters cannot be removed by moderation.

request.action: string: dismiss | warn | remove_message | suspend_user | ban | escalate
request.days: integer: for suspend_user; omit for until lifted

POST /api/admin/reports/:id/resolve.summary: Older single action: resolve (dismiss) a report with a note.

GET /api/admin/audit.summary: The audit log of staff actions, newest first. Append-only. Never holds message text or a full phone number.

GET /api/admin/users.summary: Find people. By name, or by the last 4+ digits of a phone number. Numbers are always masked here.

GET /api/admin/users/:id.summary: One person's account facts (no message content). `reveal=1` shows the full number, needs the reveal permission, and is audited.

query.reveal: string: 1 to show the full phone number

POST /api/admin/users/:id/suspend.summary: Suspend a person (sessions end at once; no sign-in, no live connection). With `days` it lifts itself.

GET /api/admin/staff.summary: The people with an admin role.

POST /api/admin/users/:id/role.summary: Give or take a staff role. Owner only. The last owner cannot be removed.

request.role: string | null: owner | moderator | support, or null to remove

GET /api/admin/analytics.summary: Usage without content: 30 daily series (sign-ups, active people, messages, new circles), weekly and monthly users, retention (day 1, 7, 30; only since activity tracking began), sealed-letter counts by status.

GET /api/admin/sms.summary: SMS operations (owner): provider, daily cap and use today, blocked calling codes, and per country (last 14 days) sent, failed, blocked, capped, verified and the completion rate. Only calling codes are stored, never numbers.

POST /api/admin/sms/blocked.summary: Replace the list of blocked country calling codes (owner). Blocked countries get no code. Audited.

request.codes: array: calling codes such as 966, up to 4 digits each

GET /api/admin/flags.summary: Platform switches (owner): signups_open, agent_enabled, sealed_enabled, with their current value and what they do.

POST /api/admin/flags/:name.summary: Turn a platform switch on or off (owner). Audited.

POST /api/circles/:id/albums.summary: Create an album (managers of a family circle): the place for photos and voices kept from an old chat.

GET /api/circles/:id/albums.summary: The circle's albums with, for each, how many photos, voices and videos per year.

POST /api/albums/:aid/items.summary: Add one file to an album (multipart: file, optional thumb, takenAt 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' as in the original chat, sender, w, h). Photos, voice recordings and videos only, judged by their bytes. Sending the same file again returns duplicate:true.

GET /api/albums/:aid/items.summary: Items of an album, oldest first, a page at a time.

query.after: integer: item id to continue after

GET /api/album-items/:id/file.summary: The file of an album item (voices play inline, Range supported); `thumb=1` gives the small preview of a photo or video.

DELETE /api/album-items/:id.summary: Remove one item from its album (managers).

DELETE /api/circles/:id/albums/:aid.summary: Remove a whole album and its files (managers).

POST /api/messages/:mid/played.summary: I started playing this voice note. Recorded once per listener; the message then lists me in playedBy and everyone gets an update frame. A no-op for the sender.

POST /api/circles/:id/uploads.summary: Start a resumable upload of one file. Nothing appears in the chat until POST /api/circles/:id/attachments is called with the finished upload ids.

request.name: string: file name
request.size: integer: total bytes (max 64 MB; a photo max 16 MB is checked at the end, by its bytes)

response.chunk: integer: the largest piece accepted, in bytes

GET /api/uploads/:uid.summary: How many bytes of this upload the server holds. Ask after a dropped connection and continue from there.

PUT /api/uploads/:uid.summary: Append one piece (raw bytes in the body, at most `chunk`). Accepted only if `offset` is exactly what the server holds; otherwise 409 with the real offset.

DELETE /api/uploads/:uid.summary: Cancel an upload and delete its bytes. Always answers ok.

POST /api/link-preview.summary: The preview of a link, asked by the SENDER's device while writing. The server fetches the page itself (public addresses only) and keeps the answer for a week. Then send the text message with `preview: <the same url>` to attach the card.

response.preview: object or null: { url, title, description, site, image (hash for /api/link-preview/image/:hash, or null) }

GET /api/link-preview/image/:hash.summary: The picture of a stored link preview (for the card above the message box). In a sent message the picture is `card.image`, a media id.

GET /api/gifs.summary: Search GIFs through the server (GIPHY, family rating). Empty q = trending. Without a provider key: configured false and no items.

query.offset: for the next page (24 per page)

response.items: array of { id, title, w, h }; the thumbnail is GET /api/gifs/:gid/preview

GET /api/gifs/:gid/preview.summary: A GIF's small thumbnail, fetched by the server. The device never contacts the provider.

POST /api/circles/:id/cards.summary: Send a contact, a location, a sticker or a GIF. It is an ordinary message with empty text and `card` set.

request.name: string: contact name (max 100)
request.label: string: optional place name (max 100)
request.id: string: sticker id, or the GIF id from /api/gifs

PUT /api/circles/:id/disappearing.summary: Set the chat's disappearing-messages timer. Applies to NEW messages only (each gets expiresAt when stored). A notice (sys disappearOn/disappearOff) goes into the chat. Private chat: either person; group: owner/admins; family circle: refused.

POST /api/messages/:mid/open.summary: Open a view-once photo, video or voice note (once per person). After 200 the file is served for 15 minutes from /api/media/:id or /api/messages/:mid/audio, then 410 view_once_gone. Before it: 403 view_once_closed. The sender sees the person in viewOnce.openedBy.

POST /api/broadcast-lists.summary: Make a list of people I share a chat with (up to 100; up to 30 lists).

GET /api/broadcast-lists/:id.summary: One of my lists with its members.

PATCH /api/broadcast-lists/:id.summary: Rename a list and/or replace its members.

DELETE /api/broadcast-lists/:id.summary: Delete a list (messages already sent stay).

POST /api/broadcast-lists/:id/chats.summary: The private chat id of each person on the list, creating missing chats. To send a broadcast the DEVICE sends one ordinary message into each chat (POST /api/circles/:id/messages). A person who blocked me (or whom I blocked) is left out with no sign.

GET /api/transcribe.summary: Is voice-to-text set up on this server?

POST /api/transcribe.summary: Turn ONE voice note into text. multipart: audio (the bytes the reader's device holds, up to 5 MB), lang (optional). Nothing is stored and the message is not changed. 10 a day per person.

PATCH /api/circles/:id/prefs.summary: My own settings for one chat (any subset). locked: the chat-lock flag only (the PIN stays on the device); a locked chat shows no preview in the list or a push. wallpaper: my background for this chat.

request.wallpaper: string|null: none | dots | dusk | dunes | forest | rose | #rrggbb; null = my default

GET /api/keys/status.summary: Is end-to-end encryption switched on in this server?

POST /api/keys/devices.summary: Register this device for encrypted chats. Its id is part of its name inside the protocol, so it comes before its key packages.

GET /api/keys/devices.summary: My devices, with their identity key and how many unused key packages each has.

POST /api/keys/devices/:did/packages.summary: Publish MLS key packages (and optionally one last-resort package) for my device. Each must name this device and carry its one identity key.

request.lastResort: string: base64, replaces the previous one

DELETE /api/keys/devices/:did.summary: Retire a device. Its packages go, and every encrypted chat of mine must change keys before anyone sends.

GET /api/keys/users/:uid.summary: The active devices of a person I share a chat with, with their identity keys (the safety number is made from them).

response.devices: array of { id, identityKey: base64, stock }

POST /api/keys/users/:uid/claim.summary: Take one key package per device of a person, to start a chat or add them. A device with none left hands out its last-resort package.

response.packages: array of { deviceId, package: base64, lastResort }

GET /api/circles/:id/e2ee.summary: The encryption state of a chat: epoch, the lowest epoch a message may carry, whether a new commit is required, and the members' devices with their identity keys.

POST /api/circles/:id/e2ee/commits.summary: Post the commit that moves the group to the next epoch, with welcomes for added devices. Only epoch = current + 1 is accepted.

GET /api/circles/:id/e2ee/commits.summary: The commits after an epoch, in order, for a device catching up.

GET /api/circles/:id/e2ee/welcomes.summary: The welcomes waiting for one of my devices in this chat (query: device).

DELETE /api/e2ee/welcomes/:wid.summary: A welcome was used: delete it.

POST /api/circles/:id/e2ee/messages.summary: Send an encrypted message (MLS ciphertext made on the device). The server keeps the bytes and a plain header (kind, epoch) and never reads text.

request.kind: string: text | media | voice | card | edit
request.epoch: number: the key epoch it was made in
request.clientMsgId: string: optional, makes a retry safe
request.uploads: string[]: finished resumable uploads of ciphertext (media, voice)
request.target: number: for edit, the message it is about
